name: nested_loop_metadata_uses_nearest_loop
template: {% for outer in [1, 2] %}O{{ loop.index }}:{% for inner in ['a', 'b'] %}{{ loop.index }}{{ inner }}{% endfor %};{% endfor %}

name: nested_loop_neighbor_items_use_nearest_loop_and_restore_outer_loop
template: {% for outer in [1, 2] %}O{{ outer }}({% for inner in ['a', 'b'] %}{{ loop.previtem }}>{{ inner }}>{{ loop.nextitem }};{% endfor %})[{{ loop.previtem }}>{{ outer }}>{{ loop.nextitem }}]{% endfor %}

name: nested_loop_changed_state_is_isolated_and_outer_state_restored
template: {% for outer in [1, 1] %}O{{ loop.changed(outer) }}:{% for inner in [1, 1, 2] %}{{ loop.changed(inner) }}{% endfor %}:{{ loop.changed(outer) }};{% endfor %}

name: nested_collection_loop_preserves_outer_list_binding
template: {% for outer in [[10]] %}{% for inner in outer %}{{ outer|length }}:{{ inner }}{% endfor %}{% endfor %}

name: nested_collection_loop_preserves_outer_tuple_binding
template: {% for outer in [(10,)] %}{% for inner in outer %}{{ outer|length }}:{{ inner }}{% endfor %}{% endfor %}

name: nested_collection_loop_preserves_outer_dict_binding
template: {% for outer in [{'a':10}] %}{% for inner in outer %}{{ outer|length }}:{{ inner }}{% endfor %}{% endfor %}
